cost: O(nm) LCS cells, O(F log F) fact maps with string comparisons; matched role scans O(sum Rx*Ry). probe runs up to4 comparisons plus membership scans.
description: Project frames to lowercased events and numbers; lexicon maps verbs/entities. Multiset counts shared events/facts, LCS aligns ordered events. Count negation, both-present modal mismatch, numbers deficit, crossing transitive nonpronoun role or named-role mismatch.
forward: Project frames to lowercased events and numbers; lexicon maps verbs/entities. Multiset counts shared events/facts, LCS aligns ordered events. Count negation, both-present modal mismatch, numbers deficit, crossing transitive nonpronoun role or named-role mismatch.
inverse: Unmatched events are gaps, not contradictions. Missing modal alone cannot contradict. Permuting complete events preserves the verb-multiset gap term. Contradictions depend on the ordered verb LCS and its tie-selected pairs: repeated verbs with different negation or roles can pair differently and increase or decrease distance. No permutation-invariance law is asserted for contradiction distance.
Logic totals admit many event sequences and fact assignments. Zero contradiction permits omitted events, missing modals and pronoun/name uncertainty; original sentences cannot be reconstructed.
limitations: No live corpus/model/teacher/GPU execution or language accuracy claim
